title: OSPF local configuration
summary: Configure and verify local OSPF process state.
brief: Configure OSPF process 100 with router ID 10.255.0.1 and advertise 10.0.0.0/8 in area 0. Verify it locally. Neighbor formation and route exchange are not simulated in this single-device lab.
hints: Enter router ospf 100 from global configuration.
show ip ospf verifies local process state, not a neighbor.

checks.label: OSPF process, router ID, and area 0 network are configured
